takeaway: Peroneus tertius belongs to the anterior compartment, not the posterior compartment of the leg.

question.text: Which of the following muscles is not found within the posterior compartment of the leg?

lines.text: Imagine the back of the calf as a house with two floors.
Upstairs, the superficial compartment holds gastrocnemius, soleus and plantaris.
Downstairs, the deep compartment holds tibialis posterior, flexor digitorum longus, flexor hallucis longus and popliteus.
All of these are supplied by the tibial nerve and the posterior tibial artery.
Now look next door: peroneus tertius is standing at a different front door.
lines.say: Now look next door: peroneus tertius is standing at a different front door. (laugh)

lines.text: It lives in the anterior compartment of the leg.
So the muscle not in the posterior compartment is peroneus tertius.
